note: Quiz 7.x is entity-based (Drupal 10/11). Global behaviour is quiz.settings (edited at /admin/quiz/config/quiz via QuizAdminForm; keys incl. has_timer, autotitle_length, revisioning, durod, remove_invalid_quiz_record, admin_review_options_end). Per-quiz behaviour is base fields on the quiz content entity (pass_rate, takes, randomization, time_limit, backwards_navigation, allow_* ...). Question types are plugins in Plugin/quiz/QuizQuestion/ with the #[QuizQuestion] attribute plus a matching quiz.question.type.<id> config entity (bundle of quiz_question). The module ships NO Drush commands. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real quiz.settings config and real quiz content entities (created with required fields type/title/randomization/keep_results/build_on_last/result_type).

evals.prompt: I enabled the Drupal Quiz module but I cannot create any questions. What else must be enabled, and technically how does Quiz discover a question type (where does the plugin live and what registers it)?
evals.expected_output: Quiz needs at least one question-type submodule enabled (quiz_multichoice, quiz_truefalse, quiz_short_answer, quiz_long_answer, quiz_matching). A question type is a plugin class in a module's Plugin/quiz/QuizQuestion/ namespace annotated with the #[QuizQuestion(id=...)] attribute (discovered by plugin.manager.quiz.question), paired with a matching quiz.question.type.<id> config entity (a bundle of quiz_question).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the Quiz module, where is the global 'show a countdown timer' option stored, what is the config key, and which admin page toggles it?
evals.expected_output: It is the has_timer key in the quiz.settings config object (with timer_format for the display). Toggle it on the global Quiz settings form at /admin/quiz/config/quiz (route quiz.admin.settings, QuizAdminForm), which needs the 'administer quiz configuration' permission.

evals.prompt: Using the Quiz module, how do I limit how many times a user can take a specific quiz and set the grade needed to pass? Are these global settings or per-quiz?
evals.expected_output: These are per-quiz base fields on the quiz entity, set on the quiz add/edit form: 'takes' (allowed number of attempts, 0 = unlimited) and 'pass_rate' (grade required to pass, with use_passfail enabled globally). They are not in quiz.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Quiz module's global settings have a non-default auto-title length configured. Inspect the live configuration and report the current autotitle_length value.
evals.expected_output: quiz.settings autotitle_length is 77 (drush cget quiz.settings autotitle_length). The shipped default is 128.

evals.prompt: This site has a quiz titled 'quiz_probe'. Inspect the live quiz entity and report the grade percentage required to pass it (its pass rate).
evals.expected_output: The quiz_probe quiz entity has pass_rate = 63 (its 'Grade required to pass' base field).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a Quiz (a quiz content entity of type 'quiz') titled exactly 'quiz_task' with a pass rate of 80 and unlimited attempts. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A quiz entity (type quiz) titled quiz_task exists with pass_rate=80 and takes=0 (unlimited). Required fields on create: type, title, randomization, keep_results, build_on_last, result_type=quiz_result.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable the Quiz module's global countdown timer so that quizzes can show a timer. Apply the change to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: quiz.settings has_timer is set to TRUE (drush cset quiz.settings has_timer 1), enabling the global quiz timer.
